subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale encrypted reasoning failures

question: Should this PR land with generic recovery in `src/agents`, or should encrypted-replay recovery first be centralized across the core and `@openclaw/ai` Responses lifecycles while retaining only Copilot-specific sanitation in the plugin?
rationale: The patch is evidence-backed, but repository policy calls for one canonical generic path and the discussion now contains overlapping open PRs for provider sanitation, core drain recovery, and `@openclaw/ai` stream recovery; automation cannot safely choose the permanent owner boundary.

options.title: Centralize recovery first
options.body: Retain the Copilot provider sanitation, move or share bounded recovery across both Responses implementations, and add sibling-path regression proof before merge.

options.title: Land with explicit scope
options.body: Merge this branch as the core-agent and Copilot fix, while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108462 as the canonical `@openclaw/ai` follow-up and documenting the remaining route gap.

options.title: Split prevention from recovery
options.body: Land a narrow Copilot sanitation change first and defer all generic retry changes until maintainers settle one shared Responses recovery design.

recommendation.title: Centralize recovery first
recommendation.body: Retain the Copilot provider sanitation, move or share bounded recovery across both Responses implementations, and add sibling-path regression proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent shared Responses retry, Copilot replay fix, and fail-closed stream guard all route through work authored or merged by this person.
